Title: Phycoprobe Data - Monthly Cleaning

Description: Add lat/lon coordinates to phycoprobe data

By: Perry

Updated: 09/2026

# Edit This Variable

```{r}
# declare the run year of interest
year <- 2024
```

# Run Code (w/o Edits)

## Process individual files

```{r}
# import packages
library(tidyverse)
source(here::here('03_Phyto/01_routine/phyco-cleaning/functions/monthly_loop.R'))
source(here::here('03_Phyto/01_routine/phyco-cleaning/functions/phyco_checks.R'))

# clean files
clean_phyco_wq_summaries(year)
```

## Combine/check them

```{r}
# combine files
df_phyco <- combine_files(year)

id_cols <- c('Month', 'Run', 'Date', 'Time', 'Latitude', 'Longitude', 'Region', 'PhycoLabel')
data_cols <- setdiff(colnames(df_phyco), id_cols)

# check files
phyco_checks(df_phyco, data_cols)
```

## Write file

```{r}
write_csv(df_phyco, fp_main_export(year))
```
